user.title: Haas+Sohn pellet stove
user.description: Enter the local IP address of your stove's Wi-Fi module and its PIN code. You can find the PIN on the stove under Menu → Network → WLAN PIN or on the label of the Wi-Fi module.

data_description.host: The IP address of the Wi-Fi module on your local network, for example 192.168.0.23.
data_description.pin: The PIN code is required to send commands to the stove.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the stove. Check the IP address and make sure the stove is powered on and reachable.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the stove status is fetched. The default is 15 seconds.

authentication_error.message: The stove rejected the command. Check the PIN code in the integration options.

communication_error.message: An error occurred while communicating with the stove: {error}

unknown_error.message: An unexpected error occurred while communicating with the stove: {error}
